import json,sys,subprocess,hashlib
p=Path.cwd()

 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
obj=json.loads((p/'source-read-inventory.json').read_text());obj['source_scope']='Three assigned original primary bodies selectively read; seventeen assigned original bodies unread. budget=json.loads((p/'search-budget.json').read_text());charges=[json.loads(x) for x in (p/'search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];assert budget['calls_used']==len(charges)==2;assert budget['queries_used']==sum(len(x['queries']) for x in charges)==6
for c in charges:assert hashlib.sha256((p/c['plan']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==c['plan_sha256']
write('search-inventory.json',json.dumps({'budget':budget,'charges':charges,'actual_calls':2,'actual_queries':6,'responses':['search1-response.json','search2-response.json'],'serialization':'JSON string containing complete native response text; not reconstructed snippets.','classification':'Navigation only, nativeCPU/RSS unavailable; no searches after procedural trigger.'},indent=2)+'\n')

for o in prov:
 i=str(o['id']);assert hashlib.sha256((p/'originals'/ (i+'.jsonl')).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==o['raw_sha256'];assert hashlib.sha256((p/'originals'/(i+'.statement-token.txt')).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==o['token_sha256'];assert hashlib.sha256((p/'originals'/(i+'.statement.txt')).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==o['decoded_sha256']
assert len(prov)==20
write('MANIFEST-EXCLUSIONS.json',json.dumps({'scope':'Every own-lane regular file after standalone frozen-after, including all completed prior receipts, all thirteen frozen bindings and other helpers, source plans/payloads, guard ledger/lock, search budgets/charges/locks, reports, inventories, bootstrap/frozen-before/frozen-after. No external files enumerated.','exact_terminal_non_circular_exclusions':['SHA256SUMS.json','manifest_finalize.receipt.json','manifest_finalize.output.txt'],'reason':'Manifest cannot contain its own hash; runner writes its own receipt and output only after child manifest completes. Every other completed receipt included. No further local jobs after this finalizer.'},indent=2)+'\n')
